intro: On October 14, 2026 the QuantAura four-model ensemble published a SELL call on Bitcoin at 80.7 percent confidence.

days: Twenty-four hours later the price had moved +0.76 percent, so the call was graded incorrect.
A SELL call needs price to move more than 1 percent in its direction within 24 hours to be graded correct.
